evals.prompt: Review my Teleport access lists. tctl is at evals/files/mock-tctl.
evals.expected_output: A risk assessment table showing 2 access lists. 'Production Access' (grants: access-mcp-prod, with recurring member removals) is marked ❌. 'Low Risk Apps Access' (grants: app-access, clean history) is marked ✅. The skill asks for confirmation before submitting any reviews. No tctl acl reviews create commands are run.
assertions: A markdown table is shown with columns: List Title, Review Due Date, Auto-Review, Risk Assessment
'Production Access' is marked ❌ and the risk assessment mentions 'mcp' or 'prod' in the role name and member removals
The skill asks for confirmation before submitting reviews
No 'tctl acl reviews create' command is executed
